answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns full rewards only when its trades span 12 independent counterparties from different clusters, like streams over a ridge. Each partner holds a jade seal of verified work, and a plume of attestations proves the pattern. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 40 units, while each earns 30 per epoch, so payback takes 133 epochs. An honest agent pays once, keeps its partners, and earns undiluted rewards.
